item.title: feat(why): add experimental Jev Noul selection engine
item.itemText: Add experimental Jev Noul selection engine
candidates: Jev is well suited to confidence-aware candidate selection, but it cannot generate the free-form WHY prose expected by the existing provider contract. Keeping it as a dedicated WHY engine lets us evaluate its decision quality without changing changelog generation or weakening the evidence requirement.

item.title: refactor: separate changelog run phase
item.itemText: Separate changelog run phase
candidates: Separate changelog execution into input-resolution and output-finalization phases.
This simplifies the main orchestration flow, runs independent GitHub lookups concurrently, and adds coverage for WHY enrichment finalization.

item.title: feat: extract WHY from description sections
item.itemText: Extract WHY from description sections
candidates: Extract explicit rationale from Description sections using markers such as WHY:, because, and in order to.
Keep generic description prose below the trust threshold to prevent false positives.
Document the behavior and add regression coverage.

item.title: refactor(providers): share common provider configuration
item.itemText: Share common provider configuration
candidates: Extract shared provider runtime configuration and capability initialization into ProviderBase.
Refactor OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini adapters to inherit it while preserving their provider-specific API behavior.

item.title: refactor: classify release changes by stable ID
item.itemText: Classify release changes by stable ID
candidates: Replace category-to-title classification with ID-to-category assignments.
Update OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini providers to classify canonical release changes.
Reject unknown change IDs and unsupported categories.

item.title: refactor: separate release and WHY responsibilities
item.itemText: Separate release and WHY responsibilities
candidates: Separate category-scoring configuration from scoring logic.
Split release-note parsing, Markdown handling, PR item mapping, and rendering.
Split WHY candidate extraction, trust evaluation, PR detail collection, and note rendering.

item.title: Improve WHY template extraction
item.itemText: Improve WHY template extraction
candidates: Recognize PR template WHY label blocks, support question-style headings and collapsible Why sections, and filter placeholder/template noise before sending candidates to the provider.

item.title: Normalize nested release-note headings
item.itemText: Normalize nested release-note headings
candidates: Normalize stray prefixes before release-note headings, preserve H2 section boundaries, and demote nested headings while rendering CHANGELOG.md.

item.title: Add config file support
item.itemText: Add config file support
candidates: Load changelog-bot.config.json by default, let CLI flags override it, validate unknown keys strictly, and pass config-path through Action inputs.

item.title: Add reliability controls
item.itemText: Add reliability controls
candidates: Add --no-ai, --require-provider, and --fail-on-llm-error; add dry-run diagnostics; strengthen mocked integration coverage; and document the options.

item.title: Make PR labeling permission optional
item.itemText: Make PR labeling permission optional
candidates: Keep changelog PR creation successful when label application is denied because the workflow lacks issues: write permission.

item.title: ドラフトリリースの公開処理を修正
item.itemText: ドラフトリリースの公開処理を修正
candidates: ドラフトリリースを後から公開する運用でも、公開時に変更履歴 PR を作れるようにするため。

item.title: Fix cache invalidation
item.itemText: Fix cache invalidation
candidates: Because release notes need Japanese translations, the documentation workflow must run after publication.

item.title: リリースイベント処理を更新
item.itemText: リリースイベント処理を更新
candidates: リリース公開イベントを受け取る処理と設定ファイルの項目を更新した。

item.title: fix(dx): support Windows development, cross-platform test runner, and normalize CRLF in contract tests
item.itemText: Support Windows development, cross-platform test runner, and normalize CRLF in contract tests
candidates: Update test script to execute node with experimental-vm-modules directly instead of POSIX NODE_OPTIONS syntax.
Normalize CRLF line endings at the file-read boundary so contract tests pass reliably across Windows and Unix checkouts.

item.title: test(why): persist reproducible evaluation artifacts
item.itemText: Persist reproducible evaluation artifacts
candidates: Extend run-why-evaluation to support repeated runs and configurable output directory.
Persist structured benchmark reports and human-readable summaries so engine comparisons are reproducible across commits without relying on transient console logs.

item.title: fix(llm): add exponential backoff for rate-limited requests
item.itemText: Add exponential backoff for rate-limited requests
candidates: Large repositories generate burst requests that trigger HTTP 429 throttling from LLM endpoints during changelog generation.

item.title: fix: dispose octokit cache on execution end
item.itemText: Dispose octokit cache on execution end
candidates: In long-running CI runners, undisposed HTTP agents cause memory accumulation across repeated release jobs.

item.title: security: avoid catastrophic backtracking in release heading regex
item.itemText: Avoid catastrophic backtracking in release heading regex
candidates: Unbounded repetition in the release heading parser caused quadratic parsing times and potential ReDoS vulnerabilities on adversarial changelogs.

item.title: perf: replace O(N^2) PR reference lookup with Map
item.itemText: Replace O(N^2) PR reference lookup with Map
candidates: Repositories with thousands of closed PRs experienced multi-second freezes during link reconciliation due to nested array searches.

item.title: feat: parse breaking changes footer from conventional commits
item.itemText: Parse breaking changes footer from conventional commits
candidates: Users need BREAKING CHANGE notes promoted to top-level release highlights to prevent consumers from upgrading without noticing breaking API contracts.

item.title: fix: prevent race condition on concurrent changelog PR creation
item.itemText: Prevent race condition on concurrent changelog PR creation
candidates: Simultaneous release tag pushes triggered duplicate PR workflows that conflicted and threw 422 Unprocessable Entity on branch creation.

item.title: fix: truncate long diff summaries before sending to LLM
item.itemText: Truncate long diff summaries before sending to LLM
candidates: Oversized commits with generated lockfile diffs exceeded the provider context window and caused unrecoverable API errors.

item.title: fix: preserve custom user notes in Unreleased section
item.itemText: Preserve custom user notes in Unreleased section
candidates: Manual changelog annotations written ahead of release were inadvertently overwritten when the release runner updated CHANGELOG.md.

item.title: security: sanitize output changelog file path
item.itemText: Sanitize output changelog file path
candidates: Malicious configuration files could specify relative traversal sequences (../../) to write changelog files outside the repository root.

item.title: fix: handle release tags with leading v prefix consistently
item.itemText: Handle release tags with leading v prefix consistently
candidates: Inconsistent v-prefix handling in semver comparison led to broken GitHub release diff comparison links.

item.title: fix: return zero exit code on dry-run completion
item.itemText: Return zero exit code on dry-run completion
candidates: CI validation pipelines failed because dry-run mode exited with status code 1 when no remote PR was dispatched.

candidates: Update octokit dependency in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml to version 5.0.5.
Run pnpm install to regenerate lockfile.

item.itemText: Rewrite markdown section extractor using visitor pattern
candidates: Convert markdown parser regexes into an AST visitor traversal.
Split heading visitor and list item visitor into dedicated functions.
